children: Indu Bhan New Delhi: The Supreme Court on Friday appointed former judge Ranjana Prakash Desai as the sole mediator after Reliance Industries and its consortium partners-UK-based BP Exploration (Alpha) and Canada-based Niko (NECO)-failed to reach an amicable settlement with the Union government in the long-running $1.73-billion Krishna-Godavari (KG) basin gas migration dispute.

A bench comprising Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and Vipul M Pancholi referred the matter for mediation. 'No solution' Attorney General R Venkataramani said that the parties had been unable to arrive at a "viable solution". The apex court said that Desai could take assistance from two domain experts as may be suggested by the parties to facilitate the mediation process. The parties assured the court that they would extend full cooperation to the mediator.

title: SC Appoints Mediator in Reliance-KG Basin Case
